title: 第21章 神秘口诀第22章 百毒不侵
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
盖一闻言哈哈大笑：“师兄，你终于肯认输了，也不枉我在这小子身上用了这天下奇毒，倒是师兄拿出了传说中的‘海棠烛泪’还是输了，这可亏大了。”
原本他九死一生找来的“百里红妆”就这样用了，他还有些懊恼，不过赢得了《万毒归宗》，一切都是值得的。
绝命毒圣冷哼一声：“他又没死，怎能算我输。小子，人的潜力无穷无尽，能否活下来，就看你自己造化了，千万不能放弃。”
此言一出，商玄镜等人又提起了几分希望。
盖一闻言撇了撇嘴：“呵呵，师兄你的解毒思路确实让我佩服，若是一个修为高深的强者，你以毒攻毒，再加上你举世无双的金针刺穴之术引导，可能大概率真把他救回来了。但这人不过一个炼体武者，身体强度根本经不住两种天下至毒交战，你费尽心机，顶多只有一成的生机而已，我九你一，优势在我！”
商玄镜这才明白刚刚他为何要特意选没有修为的女儿做比毒的宿主，原来一开始就算到了这一层。
这个少年是为了我女儿牺牲了性命……
绝命毒圣神色平静：“不到最后关头，鹿死谁手还未可知。”
“呵，故弄玄虚，我就让你输个明白。”盖一索性搬来一把小凳子坐了下来，根据他的估计，宋牧驰要不了多久要么烈火焚身而亡，要么冻成冰渣而死，毕竟两种奇毒毒性、分量不可能分毫不差，哪怕绝命毒圣金针刺穴，也绝对做不到让两种至毒之物刚好平衡。
浑身那种冰寒交替的极致痛苦让宋牧驰清楚如今谁也指望不了了，果断发动了【异象·甩锅】。
手指深深抠进了一旁的泥土中，很快整个百花谷那些花草树木要么变得焦黑，要么蒙上了一层冰霜，飞鸟蜂蝶也纷纷坠地身亡。
看到这一幕众人齐齐色变，盖一急忙拉着马车往远处退却，施展辟毒术法护住几女，她们价值连城，可不能死在这里。
话说不愧是两种绝世奇毒，单单只是外泄的毒性就已经如此霸道，连他都要避其锋芒。
商玄镜几人更是心沉谷底，这样恐怖的毒，那个少年哪还有命在。
她下意识闭上眼睛，不愿再看那少年的惨状。
绝命毒圣并没有退却，周身隐隐可见光华流转，将那恐怖的剧毒挡在身外。
看到这一幕盖一又嫉又妒，《万毒归宗》果然不同凡响，幸好我这次聪明，另外选了第三方来斗毒。
仔细打量着宋牧驰的状况，绝命毒圣眼神微眯，忽然传音入密：“按照我教的口诀，努力让体内的几种毒素达到平衡。”
“玄泉落九渊，赤乌照丹庭。
抱月阴符转，衔阳坎水腾。

水火既济处，龙虎叩玉关。
雷动风生髓，云蒸雨润田。
……”
宋牧驰早已陷入了无尽的黑暗与痛苦中，随时都要死去。
哪怕他能通过异象将五成伤害甩出去，可任意一种奇毒，哪怕只有五成伤害也能让他死上一百次。
这声音仿佛天道之音，在黑暗中照亮了一束光。
他无暇思考，本能地按照那口诀运气，仿佛进入了一个特殊的世界。
他“看到”空间中一朵妖异的桃花，一滴鲜艳的红泪，各自颜色几乎各自占据半个世界。
除了它们之外，似乎还有一团青色的雾气占据着一个极小的地盘。
这似乎是春秋造化丹之毒。
正因为这团青色雾气，导致整个世界还剩下稍许空隙。
没想到鱼忠贤给他下毒，反倒间接救了他。
不过他清楚整个世界迟早会被桃花和红泪的颜色填满，到时候迎接他的就是死亡。
平衡……
宋牧驰若有所悟，之前他是将伤害转移出去，可哪怕整个百花谷变得死寂也无法解决剩下的五成伤害。
可如果是将那些伤害转移到另一种奇毒身上呢？
于是他施展甩锅的能力，将那桃花对他的侵蚀转移到那滴红泪的地盘，同时又将红泪的侵蚀转移到桃花的地盘。
一瞬间，整个世界仿佛炸开了锅。
原本似乎保持默契井水不犯河水的桃花和红泪开始激烈交锋起来，局势当真是此起彼伏。
宋牧驰立马感觉到身上的痛苦一轻，他心中大喜，继续按照那些口诀以及甩锅的能力煽风点火。

同时还根据战局变化，引导青色雾气的力量去相助劣势者。
整个过程青色雾气被消耗得越来越少，直到消失不见。
但桃花和红泪的地盘也逐渐趋于稳定，最终形成了一副太极的图案，只不过一粉一红。
content_en:
Gai Yi laughed loudly when he heard this: "Senior brother, you are finally willing to admit defeat. It is not in vain that I used this strange poison on this kid. However, senior brother took out the legendary 'Begonia Candle Tears' and still lost. This is a big loss."
He was still a little upset when he used the "Baili Hongzhuang" that he had found after a narrow escape, but winning "Ten Thousand Poisons Returns to the Clan" made everything worth it.
The Deadly Poison Saint snorted coldly: "He's not dead, so how can I be considered a loser? Boy, people's potential is endless. Whether you can survive depends on your own destiny. Don't give up."
As soon as these words came out, Shang Xuanjing and others raised some hopes.
Gai Yi curled his lips when he heard this: "Haha, senior brother, I really admire your idea of detoxification. If he is a strong man with advanced cultivation, you fight poison with poison, and coupled with your unparalleled golden needle pricking technique, you may really save him with a high probability. But this person is just a body-refining warrior, and his body strength cannot withstand the battle between two kinds of poisons in the world. You have tried so hard, but at most you only have 10% chance of survival. I am the one with you, the advantage is mine!"
Only then did Shang Xuanjing understand why he specifically chose his daughter who had no cultivation level to be the host of the poison competition. It turned out that she had reached this level from the beginning.
This young man sacrificed his life for my daughter...
The Deadly Poison Saint looked calm: "Until the last moment, we still don't know who will win."
"Oh, I'm trying to make a fool of myself. I'll let you lose." Gai Yi simply brought a small stool and sat down. According to his estimation, Song Muchi would either be burned to death or freeze to death in a short time. After all, the toxicity and weight of the two strange poisons cannot be exactly the same. Even if the deadly poison holy gold needle is inserted into the acupuncture point, there is absolutely no way to balance the two most poisonous substances.
The extreme pain of alternating ice and cold all over his body made Song Muchi realize that no one could count on him now, so he decisively activated [Vision·Putting the blame].
His fingers dug deeply into the soil on the side, and soon the flowers, plants and trees in the entire Baihua Valley either turned black or were covered with a layer of frost, and the birds, bees and butterflies also fell to the ground and died.
Seeing this scene, everyone's expressions changed. Gai Yi hurriedly pulled the carriage and retreated far away, using poison-proofing magic to protect the girls. They were extremely valuable and could not die here.
It is true that they are two peerless poisons. The poisonousness alone is so overbearing that even he has to avoid its edge.
Shang Xuanjing and others were even more depressed. How could that young man still be alive after being exposed to such terrifying poison?
She closed her eyes subconsciously, not wanting to see the young man's miserable condition again.
The Deadly Poison Saint did not retreat, and brilliance could be seen faintly flowing around his body, blocking the terrifying poison.
Seeing this scene, Gai Yi was jealous and envious. "The Return of All Poisons" is indeed extraordinary. Fortunately, I was smart this time and chose a third party to fight the poison.
Carefully observing Song Muchi's condition, the Deadly Poison Saint narrowed his eyes and suddenly transmitted a secret message: "Follow the formula I taught, and try to balance the several toxins in the body."
"The mysterious spring falls into the abyss, and the red crow shines on the alchemy court.
Holding the moon, the yin talisman turns, holding the yang bank and the water rises.
Water and fire are both helpful, and the dragon and tiger knock on the jade pass.
The thunder and wind bring forth the marrow, and the clouds and rain moisten the fields.
…”
Song Muchi had already fallen into endless darkness and pain, and was about to die at any time.
Even if he can throw away 50% of the damage through visions, any kind of strange poison can kill him a hundred times even if it only deals 50% of the damage.
This voice was like the voice of heaven, illuminating a beam of light in the darkness.
He had no time to think and instinctively followed the formula to make luck, as if he had entered a special world.
He "saw" a strange peach blossom and a bright red tear in the space, each color occupying almost half of the world.
In addition to them, there seems to be a group of cyan mist occupying a very small area.
This seems to be the poison of the Spring and Autumn Creation Pill.
It is precisely because of this blue mist that there is still a little space left in the world.gap.
Unexpectedly, Yu Zhongxian poisoned him and indirectly saved him.
But he knew that sooner or later the whole world would be filled with the color of peach blossoms and red tears, and what would greet him then would be death.
Balance…
If Song Muchi realized something, he had diverted the damage away before, but even if the entire Baihua Valley became dead, he could not solve the remaining 50% of the damage.
But what if those injuries were transferred to another strange poison?
So he used his ability to shift blame, transferring the erosion of the peach blossom to the territory of the red tear, and at the same time transferred the erosion of the red tear to the territory of the peach blossom.
In an instant, the whole world seemed to explode.
Taohua and Honglei, who originally seemed to have a tacit understanding of not violating the river, began to fight fiercely, and the situation was really ups and downs.
Song Muchi immediately felt the pain in his body lighten up. He was overjoyed and continued to fan the flames according to those formulas and his ability to blame others.
At the same time, according to changes in the battle situation, the power of the cyan mist is guided to help the disadvantaged.
During the whole process, the cyan mist was consumed less and less until it disappeared.
But the territory of Peach Blossom and Honglei gradually stabilized, and finally formed a Tai Chi pattern, only one pink and one red.
